## Enumerations

### `NetdOpcode` { #netdopcode }

One-byte opcodes on netd's service port.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NETD_GET_NETIF` | `1` | Read the interface configuration ([NetdNetif](#netdnetif)). |
| `NETD_DRVHANDSHAKE_INIT` | `2` | Driver begins: grants its doorbell and sends its MAC. |
| `NETD_DRVHANDSHAKE_STAGE2` | `3` | Grants the tx ring's memory. |
| `NETD_DRVHANDSHAKE_STAGE3` | `4` | Grants the rx ring's memory; the reply holds the name. |
| `NETD_DRVNOTIFY` | `5` | Reserved; unused. |
| `NETD_DRVWATCH` | `6` | Reserved; unused. |
| `SOCKET_UDP` | `7` | Reserved; sockets use the SOCK_* commands in net/socket.h. |
| `SOCKET_UDP_RECV` | `8` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_UDP_SENDTO` | `9` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_TCP` | `10` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_TCP_RECV` | `11` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_TCP_SEND` | `12` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_TCP_ACCEPT` | `13` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_BIND` | `14` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_CONNECT` | `15` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_LISTEN` | `16` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_CLOSE` | `17` | Reserved. |
| `SOCKET_IP` | `18` | Reserved: raw IP sockets. |
| `SOCKET_FRAME` | `19` | Reserved: raw Ethernet sockets. |
| `NETD_OPCODE_COUNT` | `20` | Number of opcodes. |
